survivors.title: Field Fixer
survivors.pitch: Document field technician's repair shortcuts as augmented reality guidance

survivors.title: Swage for jewelry workshops
survivors.pitch: For jewelry workshops, unsearchable job cards. The machine plate unlocks the exact manual page: piece tracking ready in minutes, prints compliance badges on the spot.

verdicts.attack: Walkaround videos becoming check logs requires too much manual validation to be truly 'zero signal'
verdicts.why: Generic field documentation solution with unclear differentiation

verdicts.attack: Jewelry workshops may not need compliance badges as urgently as claimed
verdicts.why: Specific, clever use of computer vision for niche manufacturing workflow

verdicts.attack: Plumbing job photos to logs is a well-trodden field with many competitors
verdicts.why: Too similar to existing construction documentation apps

verdicts.attack: AR guidance requires precise device calibration and may not work reliably in field conditions
verdicts.why: Ambitious but potentially transformative for technical knowledge transfer
